notes.title: The first update is here - Microtransactions removed
notes.notes:
As community requested the microtransactions system has been removed with this update. The way of gaining additional moves and hints is changed: When you have less than 3 available hints or less than 10 additional building moves, the game starts counting down and after 15 minutes the player receives the new hint (10 minutes for the additional move).

What's new:
- in-Apps removed
- new way of gaining hints/moves
- additional button for resetting the level (next to pause button)
- few minor changes

Thanks for the suggestions and patience!
